engine: A PER-WORD split headline reveal. The atom takes an element holding a headline, splits it into per-word spans (each WORD wrapped in its own overflow:hidden clip row), and reveals the words with a wave stagger: each word RISES from under its own clip (yPercent 120 -> 0) + fades in. The words arrive one by one, with weight. Distinct from mask-up-title (whole-line mask), blur-reveal-stagger-title (per-char blur) and stroke-draw-title (SVG stroke): only THIS one does independent per-WORD travel.

measured_teardown.move:
split the headline text into words; wrap each word in a .swh-clip (overflow hidden) holding a .swh-word inner span that carries the transform. Reveal each word with translateY(120% -> 0%) + opacity(0 -> 1), staggered by `stagger` seconds in a wave (trigger:'enter' plays once on scroll-in via ScrollTrigger) OR driven by set(p) (trigger:'progress' scrub: each word gets its own overlapping slice of p so they cascade across 0..1). Multi-line: explicit
or \n in the markup starts a new clip ROW so each line clips independently. set(p) is a PURE function of progress (reversible).
measured_teardown.cited: hero titles where the WORDS arrive one by one with weight: a reusable typographic primitive distinct from line-mask, per-char-blur and stroke-draw families.

stagger.what: seconds between consecutive words in the enter-mode wave. Larger = slower cascade.

from.yPercent.what: the per-word start offset under its own clip; 120 keeps the word fully below the clip box before it rises.

from.opacity.what: the per-word start opacity (0 = fade in with the rise).

ease.what: named token ('air'=expo.out, 'silk'=cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), 'power'=power3.out) or any gsap ease string. Per-site overridable.

trigger.what: 'enter' = play() the wave once when the headline scrolls in (top 78%); 'progress' = drive set(p) via a scroll scrub so the cascade tracks scroll 1:1.

start.what: ScrollTrigger start for the enter-mode one-shot.

dur.what: per-word travel duration in enter mode.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance (true) or let the page drive a shared Lenis (false, default; the page usually owns it for a hero).

entry:
SplitWordHeadline.create(target, opts) -> { words, trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), refresh(), destroy }. target = an element holding a headline (e.g.

); the atom splits it into per-word clip rows. Use \n or
for lines. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the per-word cascade; play() runs the one-shot wave.
law: transform translateY(% via yPercent) + opacity on the inner .swh-word spans + overflow:hidden per-word .swh-clip only. NO layout-prop animation (no margin/top/width/height). GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL. will-change cleared after the one-shot completes. reduced-motion or <=560px -> all words shown (no travel). owns_pin false (lives inside a hero/section, never pins). GSAP required; ScrollTrigger required for the enter/progress triggers; set(p) works standalone.
gate_mode: play-once-on-enter (default) or scroll-scrub (trigger:'progress'). Verify: the headline is split into per-word clip rows (each WORD in its own overflow:hidden box); on reveal each word RISES from under its own clip (translateY 120% -> 0%) + fades, staggered in a wave; multi-line headlines clip per line. Distinct from mask-up-title (one mask over the whole line) and blur-reveal-stagger-title (per-char blur). Smoothness via fps on enter / scrub.
proven: lab: a 2-word UA serif headline ('Дім дихає') over OUR QUADRO render renders/day-34.webp, plus a multi-line headline to prove per-line clipping. Measured live: words start translateY(120%)/opacity 0, rise to translateY(0%)/opacity 1 in a staggered wave; per-word clips = overflow hidden (each word masked under its own box). set(p) PURE and reversible. window.__LAB_OK__ true once wired + render painted. Serif stand-in = Playfair Display (Canela / PP-Editorial class).
